Fueling Deicing

nạp nhiên liệu

Quantity of fuel added during a refuelling operation, expressed in kilograms, litres or pounds.

Questions and answers

What is nạp nhiên liệu?

In this glossary, nạp nhiên liệu refers to: Quantity of fuel added during a refuelling operation, expressed in kilograms, litres or pounds.

How is nạp nhiên liệu used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Nhân viên tiếp nhiên liệu: Hoàn tất nạp nhiên liệu yêu cầu; thêm 3.400 kg, tổng nhiên liệu trên máy bay hiện 7,5 tấn."

Definition

Quantity of fuel added during a refuelling operation, expressed in kilograms, litres or pounds.

Operational example

Fueler: Requested fuel uplift complete; three thousand four hundred kilograms added, total onboard fuel now seven point five tonnes.
